light.prompt:
Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: new OPDA Join-page campaign professional judgement landscape. Scene: a mature South Asian female property practitioner in a petrol jacket calmly explains an unusual room detail to two colleagues at a broad window alcove, pointing with a pencil to her own open unlettered inspection sketchbook; the younger colleague in coral leans in and listens, while an older Black male colleague in violet retains a separate closed source portfolio securely in his own hands. The sketchbook shows a simple doorway observation only, not a house cutaway or technical diagram. Window and a quiet plain wall create a shallow setting; no large desk, no pile of files. Their attentive faces and distinct ownership of materials show professional experience and authority remaining with people.
Style: OPDA editorial watercolour, rich translucent washes and softly opaque gouache, fine natural deep-purple pen-and-ink contours, delicate hatching and tactile pigment variation. Warm humane professional magazine illustration, not stock vector art. Cool off-white #F9F9F9 paper with generous OPDA gold #FEC92B, petrol teal #0E8478, blue-violet #6C5BD4 and supporting coral; natural skin tones. New faces and new setting, not a repeated generic desk scene. Final1536×512pixels,3:1ultra-wide shallow panorama; if larger native canvas, exact3:1. No layout change. All complete heads, hands and essential objects comfortably inside with narrow quiet margins, no large blank bands. One coherent illustration, no panels, border, montage, text, letters, numerals, labels, logos, watermark, approvals, stamps, arrows, diagrams, floatingicons, handshake,3D,photography,neon or glow. Human lesson, no architecturalcutaway.
